name: customer-feedback
description: A Customer Feedback document with three chunks (one customer_feedback item per chunk) alongside a Product document change. Exercises the chunk-based customer_feedback path plus document_change in the same run.
founderContext: Summarize what customers said about billing, onboarding, and SSO this week.

versions.changelog: Reworked pricing tiers and added an annual billing option.

chunks.content: Several customers asked for annual billing instead of monthly-only.
Onboarding occasionally retries before completing and needs clearer recovery feedback.
Multiple requests for SSO / SAML so larger teams can roll out access.
